subjectId.description: Identifier of the resource this case governs

subjectVersion.description: Immutable subject version or proposal revision being reviewed

policyVersion.description: Applicable policy version captured when the case started

initiatorUserId.description: User who opened the case, or null if the user was deleted

parentCaseId.description: Parent case identifier, for future compound operations

selfApprovalAllowed.description: Whether the captured policy allows the initiator to decide their own case

payload.description: Opaque domain payload reference, e.g. a proposal revision id

initiationFields.description: Configured fields captured when the case was initiated

escalatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the case was escalated, or null if not escalated
